name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or a team as a photo or initials, alone or stacked.
use: A person, a team or a project shown as a photo, or as one or two initials when there is no photo. The box keeps the same size either way. Where the photo may fail to load, put an avatar-fallback under it and attach the avatar behavior, which shows the fallback instead of a broken image.

instead.when: The picture is a symbol, not someone
The person is named inside a sentence

classes.name: avatar
classes.description: The circle, 32px; it holds initials or an avatar-image. Initials need role="img" and aria-label with the name

classes.name: avatar-image
classes.description: The photo, cropped to the circle; its alt is the person's name

classes.name: avatar-square
classes.description: A rounded square with a corner a quarter of its size, for a team, a project or an organization

classes.name: avatar-fallback
classes.description: Initials or an icon in the same cell as the avatar-image, shown until the photo loads and again if it fails. Hide it with aria-hidden and name the avatar with role="img" and aria-label; give the photo an empty alt

classes.name: avatar-status
classes.description: A presence dot on the lower end of the circle, cut out by a ring of the surface behind it; say the status in the accessible name as well

classes.name: avatar-badge
classes.description: A picture on the lower end corner that says what someone is (verified, a company, a team): two fifths of the avatar, cut out by a ring of the surface behind it, round or, on avatar-square, a rounded square. An icon goes inside, or it is the image itself. Say what it means in the avatar's name, and never put it beside an avatar-status

classes.name: avatar-group
classes.description: A stack: each avatar overlaps the one before it by a quarter of its size, separated by a 2px ring of the surface color

properties.name: --avatar-ring
properties.description: Color of the ring around a stacked avatar and a status dot. It is not declared: it falls back to --surface-color, then to --color-surface-base

properties.name: --avatar-status
properties.description: Color of the status dot. It is not declared: it falls back to --color-success

properties.name: --avatar-badge-size
properties.description: The size of the corner badge

example: GH AT

states.name: failed
states.description: The photo failed or has no source; the avatar behavior hides it and the fallback shows

states.name: loaded
states.description: The photo has loaded; the avatar behavior hides the fallback under it
